response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile full-stack engineer with deep web/Node.js/TypeScript and DLang experience, but the role demands hands-on senior C++ expertise. His C++ exposure is minimal and dated (a 7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a bachelor thesis project), and he shows no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure development practices, MQTT/industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain experience. While he has relevant distributed-systems and low-latency experience (albeit in DLang), the core technical alignment with this C++-centric industrial role is weak.
strengths: Extensive systems experience with low-latency, high-throughput services (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, testable design, plus mentoring/teaching track record
Broad polyglot background including event-driven architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, and open-source contributions
concerns: Very limited and outdated C++ experience (~7 months in 2014–2015); C++ not even listed in current skills
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443), SDL, MQTT, OPC UA, or automation/OT protocols
Career trajectory centered on web/full-stack product work, not embedded/industrial platform engineering

key_factors.factor: No industrial security or protocol experience
